name: Evlek Brand Film — V4.7 master pair (kurul final geçişi: duvar/karton inversiyonu, tek-kütle baskılar)
note: Large binaries stay out of git (working rule 12); they are pinned here by checksum. Both are rendered from the Remotion source at the commit named below — the master is NEVER produced by transcoding a lossy MP4. To reproduce: render BrandFilmV4 with --codec=prores --prores-profile=hq --muted, then derive the social file with the exact ffmpeg command below.

social.encode_command: ffmpeg -i evlek_master_prores_v47.mov -c:v libx264 -preset slower -crf 14 -tune grain -profile:v high -level 4.2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 60 -fps_mode cfr -x264-params keyint=120:min-keyint=120:scenecut=0:open-gop=0 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 -color_range tv -movflags +faststart -an evlek_brandfilm_v47_1080x1920_60fps.mp4

izleme.note: chat-preview copy only; same chain, not a deliverable
